balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: A tiled balcony has a surface finish and a waterproofing layer beneath it. Cracked grout, pooling water or staining underneath can signal a problem, but the visible symptom alone does not establish the full repair. We assess the accessible balcony and discuss what may need to be opened before confirming the work.
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 瓷砖阳台由表面饰面及下方防水层组成。填缝开裂、积水或下方水渍可能提示问题，但可见症状不能单独确定完整维修范围。我们先评估阳台，并说明可能需打开的区域，再确认施工。

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Tell us where water appears and whether it follows rain or cleaning. Ponding needs the floor falls, finished levels and outlet connection assessed together; regrouting alone cannot correct the drainage arrangement. Door thresholds and edge junctions can limit the available build-up and affect whether tiles need removal.
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 请说明水出现的位置，以及是否在下雨或清洗后出现。积水需要结合地面坡度、完成面高度与排水口连接评估；单独重新填缝不能纠正排水布局。门槛及边缘交接也可能限制可增加的厚度，影响是否需要拆砖。

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Tiles, door tracks and balcony edges can conceal important connections. We explain any access or removal needed before specifying a repair. Regrouting or coating over existing tiles does not establish that the membrane underneath is sound or resolve an inaccessible junction.
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 瓷砖、门轨和阳台边缘可能遮住重要连接。指定维修方式前，我们会解释需要的进入或拆除工作。在旧砖上重新填缝或涂层，不能证明下方防水膜完好，也不能解决无法接近的交接问题。

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Balcony level, safe access, building occupancy and the route for removing materials influence how the work is organised. Let us know if the balcony belongs to an apartment or shared building and whether access arrangements need coordination. We confirm practical access before scheduling the agreed work.
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 阳台楼层、安全通道、建筑使用情况及材料搬运路线影响施工组织。请告知是否为公寓或共用建筑、是否需协调进出。我们会先确认实际通行条件，再安排施工。

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Where renewal is needed, the sequence may include tile removal, base repairs, preparation of outlets and junctions, membrane installation and curing before reinstatement. The chosen system and exposed condition guide the detail. For the finish, see our
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 需要更新时，工序可能包括拆砖、基层维修、排水口与接缝准备、防水膜安装及养护，之后恢复饰面。细部做法取决于选定系统和暴露条件。饰面施工请查看

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Area, removal depth, base condition and the number of junctions and outlets affect the quote. Threshold alterations, difficult access and the availability of replacement tiles may add work beyond the initial visible damage. We identify the work included and discuss any further condition revealed during removal before extending the scope.
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 面积、拆除深度、基层状况、接缝与排水口数量影响报价。门槛改造、困难通行和替换砖供应可能增加可见损伤以外的工作。我们列明包含项目，拆除发现新状况时会先讨论，再扩大范围。

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: We plan preparation, application and curing around the weather and the selected materials. After assessment, we explain the expected balcony closure and the sequence for restoring the finish.
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 我们结合天气与所选材料安排基层处理、施工和养护。评估后说明阳台预计停用时间，以及恢复饰面的工序。

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Keep people, furniture and other loads off the affected area until the agreed return-to-use point. Handover guidance covers the installed finish and any restrictions during curing. Avoid fixing items through the treated surface without first checking how that would affect the waterproofing detail.
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 在约定的恢复使用时间前，请勿让人员、家具或其他载荷进入施工区域。交付说明包括饰面保养及养护限制。向处理过的表面钻孔固定物品前，应先确认对防水细部的影响。

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Keep accessible drainage points clear and report renewed pooling or staining. A change in water flow after the work deserves attention. See the
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 保持可接触排水口畅通，积水或水渍再次出现时及时反馈。完工后水流发生变化也值得检查。请参阅

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 阳台瓷砖下的室外防水系统选材

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: For a tiled balcony, we check exterior and under-tile suitability together. Water-based does not mean indoor-only, while approval for outdoor use does not automatically permit permanent exposure. The selected membrane, primer, threshold and outlet details must work with the tile adhesive, falls and movement joints. We identify any protective covering and weather-dependent curing stages in the written scope.
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 铺砖阳台需同时核对室外与瓷砖下使用适用性。水性不代表只能室内使用，允许室外使用也不自动代表可长期外露。所选膜层、底涂、门槛和排水口节点，应与瓷砖胶、排水坡度及变形缝配合。我们在书面范围中明确所需保护覆盖层及受天气影响的养护阶段。

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Rain-related balcony leaks need a defined repair boundary
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 雨后阳台渗漏需要明确修复边界

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: Water below a tiled balcony after rain can involve an outlet connection, a doorway or perimeter junction, or the membrane beneath the tiles. Surface pooling and cracked grout are useful observations, but neither identifies the whole leak path. Tell us whether water appears below only after rain, how long it takes and whether the doorway or adjoining wall also becomes wet.
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 铺砖阳台在雨后向下渗水，可能涉及排水口连接、门槛或周边交接处，也可能涉及砖下防水层。表面积水与填缝开裂都是有用线索，但不能单凭其中一种现象确定完整进水路径。请说明是否只在雨后向下渗水、多久后出现，以及门槛或相邻墙体是否同时变湿。

balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: A local flexible joint repair suits a confirmed joint defect only where the adjoining materials remain suitable. Membrane renewal involves a different removal and reinstatement scope. We assess the base, thresholds, falls and outlet details before agreeing what can be retained. Adding grout or another tile layer will not restore a failed concealed membrane.
balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 局部弹性接缝修复适用于已确认的接缝缺陷，且相邻材料状态仍适合保留的情况。防水层更新则涉及不同的拆除与恢复范围。我们先评估基层、门槛、坡度与排水口节点，再商定哪些部分可以保留。补填缝或覆盖一层新砖不能恢复已失效的隐蔽防水层。
